sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.baseline_cd4 REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
          WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
            AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
            AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND r.test_concept_id IN (
                164986,
                165290,
                199990
            )
            AND r.test_value_concept_id IN (703)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
          WHERE a.patient_id = s.patient_id
            AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
            AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND LOWER(a.crag_test_results) LIKE '%positive%'
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_diagnosis d
      WHERE d.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND d.voided = 0
        AND DATE(d.date_created) >= :startDate
        AND DATE(d.date_created) <= :endDate
        AND d.diagnosis_coded IN (
            1294,
            169776
        )
  );
